name: video-workflow
description: Turn a locked script into a synchronized, verified video with reusable formats, themes, narration providers, and a deterministic renderer.

interface.shortDescription: Build synchronized videos from locked scripts
interface.longDescription: Create an isolated video project from a locked script, select a content template and format, generate or import narration, synchronize captions and animation, normalize audio, verify timing, and render a final MP4 without HyperFrames or Remotion.
defaultPrompt: Turn this locked script into a verified vertical video.
Build a six-item list video from this script.
Check this video project for caption, audio, and timing drift.
